plan.title: 1-Week Math Quiz Prep Plan
plan.summary: A targeted 1-week study plan focusing on Numerical Ability, percentages, and averages with 1 hour of daily practice to get you ready for your quiz.

weeks.milestone: Complete a timed math mock test and review weak spots.

tasks.activity: Solve 25 basic arithmetic questions and review fundamental rules.
Learn fraction-to-percentage conversions and solve 20 problems.
Practice 20 average calculation shortcuts and weighted average sums.
Practice 25 mixed word problems focusing on speed and accuracy.
Review key formulas and mistakes from previous practice sets.
Take a 45-min math mock test and review incorrect answers.
Quick formula recap and rest before your quiz.

tips: Keep a formula notebook handy to review daily.
Focus on accuracy before speed during the first few days.

form.goal: [TEST] Prepare for a maths quiz in 1 week, 1 hour a day
